newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens Nixdorf says 8 month sales rose.
newsitem.headline: Siemens Nixdorf says 8 month sales rose.

text.p: Siemens Nixdorf Informationssysteme AG said on Tuesday its sales in the first eight months of its fiscal year rose 11 percent to 9.4 billion marks ($5.4 billion).
The Siemens AG unit's sales outside Germany were up 14 percent from the year-earlier period to 3.7 billion marks. The company's fiscal year starts on October 1.
Incoming orders rose 11 percent to 10 billion marks, also boosted by orders from outside Germany, which were up 15 percent to 4.1 billion marks.
-- Terence Gallagher, Bonn newsroom, 49-228-2609750 ($ = 1.731 German Marks)
